title: The Statistical Cost of Adaptation in Multi-Source Transfer Learning
summary: Multi-source transfer learning can improve target-domain estimation by leveraging related source data, but its benefits depend on unknown source-to-target biases. This raises a fundamental question: can a bias-agnostic estimator perform as well as an oracle that knows the true bias configuration? To study this, we introduce the intrinsic cost of adaptation, defined as the smallest worst-case ratio between the risk of any bias-agnostic estimator and the oracle risk.
